description: Unique sequential transaction identifier. Use for record tracking only; exclude from predictive features.
Date and time of the transaction in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS format. Can be used to derive hour/day/time features after leakage checks.
Masked card token that groups some transactions to the same simulated card. It is still an identifier; do not use raw token as a direct predictive feature or expose unnecessarily.
Transaction amount represented as a numeric value with two decimal places. The source file does not specify the currency.
Merchant industry/category of the transaction, e.g. Fuel, Online, Healthcare. Use categorical encoding fitted on training data only.
Label: 0 = legitimate transaction, 1 = transaction labelled fraudulent. This is the target for supervised comparisons and evaluation only; never include it in input features.
Identifier for the merchant. Potentially high-cardinality; exclude or encode using a training-only method and assess leakage risk.
Payment card type: Credit, Debit, or Prepaid. Encode using preprocessing fitted on training data only.
